description: Docker images pinned in Ansible role defaults as `<name>_image: "repo:tag"`. These live in plain YAML vars that no built-in manager scans, so the image pins across ansible-proxmox-apps roles (prometheus_stack, netmon, qdrant_docker, ntfy_docker, mailpit_docker, etc.) were untracked by Renovate. Matched as the `docker` datasource so Renovate bumps the tag in place; image refs are self-describing (repo:tag) so no per-line `# renovate:` annotation is needed. Untagged refs (no colon) are not matched; local-only tags resolve to nothing and are skipped.

customManagers is mergeable:true, so this concatenates with — does not replace — the Nix version-pin manager in the JacobPEvans/.github:renovate-presets preset this config extends. Lives in dryvist/.github so every dryvist repo inherits it; JacobPEvans-personal repos do not. Promote this manager into the renovate-presets entry point if/when those repos need the same coverage.
